name: article-footnotes
title: Article footnotes
description: Footnote references and a notes list with working back links, so a long article can cite sources without breaking the flow.
docs: Wrap the article in Footnotes with a list of notes, each with a stable id, its content and optionally a source (label, href and the day you read it). Put FootnoteRef note="id" in the text where a claim needs one and FootnoteList wherever the notes belong, usually at the end. A reference takes its number from the place of its note in the list, so numbers follow the list while the anchors (#fn-id for a note, #fnref-id for the spot in the text) keep working when notes are added or moved. Following a reference puts focus on the note, which is also highlighted when a link targets it; the back link returns focus to the exact sentence. A note that is cited twice sets mentions to 2, and the second FootnoteRef passes mention=2. Notes use the muted colour at 14px or larger, with the source line in the foreground colour. Pass labels, title and backLabel to translate the fixed words, and locale for the date.
